selected: one bridge per physical die, existing four providers shared, no duplicate PC/controller/tag-owner macros
system_host_DMA: existing ot_hbm_host_dma_shared64 ND96/ND4 takes real burst master outputs

provider_request.caller: all16 actual loader tag bits including STOREclass15
provider_request.identity: actual hardware owner supplies192bit identity; stack/sector/caller must equal current formatter/tag, localdie1 preserved
provider_request.producer: hardware lease/producer, never generated Python payload or synthetic oracle
provider_request.global_rank: 7bits retained outside contained per-die id.die1 namespace

provider_owned.return_flags: owned_we actual write visibility, owned_credit actual positive reverse grant

service_ports.other_clients: actual owned client6 demux; non-loader data/reversegrants pass unchanged, reverse credit per-stack held2:1 arbitration

flow: request -> exact owned DATA/physical write visibility -> actual loader rsp handshake -> retained full reverse tuple -> actual credit acceptance -> matching owned_credit grant -> next request
refusal: missing hardware identity holds without fabricated identity
foreign id/caller/we/beat refuses ACK and retains state
partial strobes on writes refused rather than discarded
reverse credit grant is not a second loader reply

latency.one_outstanding_effect: cold per-die payload throughput <=32B/(actual request->owned reply+reverse-grant interval); not MAXOUT/VOUT parallel throughput
latency.no_free_overlap: source preload and STORE readback charged separately; actual service arbitration/row waits/reverse grant expose stalls

physical: existing model constants and positive mux/compare/storage estimate; placement/loadedSSFF of bridge required, original loader/provider closure not transferred
next_parent_hooks: bind actual hardware owner issuer identity, not constant dummy values
bind existing shared stack provider req/owned/credit ports
Erdos binds actual resident/window storage allocator and provider destinations; no wstream-count payload credit
